OWNER ACCEPTANCE, RESTATED AFTER INSPECTING THE LIVE PAGE: http://127.0.0.1:8765/scala/getting-started/ is better, but it is still extremely thin for this library. The owner is explicit: the documentation must show what the library does with code snippets, explanations, output, plots, and so on.

The live page currently demonstrates only source text to SurfaceAtlas: paragraphs, sentences, tokens, spans, and a fixture inventory. That is a sound first lesson, not a sufficient answer to what storymodel4s does.

THE MINIMUM USER JOURNEY REMAINS SIX EXECUTABLE WORKFLOWS:
1. MODEL A STORY: inspect evidence-linked entities, situations, contexts, claims, relations, and time. Use the War of the Ghosts fixture honestly as a researcher-reviewed acceptance model, not automatic extraction.
2. REPRESENT A RECALL: construct recall units and recall-side relations while preserving recall wording and discourse structure.
3. ALIGN AND INTERPRET: run sparse partial alignment, show source versus external destinations, explain omissions/reordering/merges, and include the build-derived static plot already specified.
4. COMPUTE SUPPORT-AWARE SUMMARIES: RecallSignature outputs, n/a states, support numerators and denominators, estimand identity, and failure cases. No point estimate when the universe is Unestablished.
5. SCORE AN INTERVIEW: transcript atlas, detail atoms, memory addresses, target-episode induction, and profile outputs, including what uncertainty and external detail mean.
6. SAVE AND DELIVER: round-trip the canonical StoryModelCodec and produce the self-contained CodexHtml bundle with code, receipts, HTML outcome, and auditable partial-delivery states.

EACH GUIDE NEEDS complete imports, deterministic input, exact command, exact captured output, interpretation, limitation/failure behavior, source identity, and at least one meaningful accessible static visual where relationships or uncertainty benefit from it. A module catalogue is useful reference, but it cannot substitute for these tasks.

CURRENT VERDICT: the repaired align-and-interpret page is one substantive slice and still lacks its figure. The other five workflows are absent. Do not propose or describe the docs stack as answering the owner yet. I am preparing an independent public-API model-a-story receipt once the running all-platform gate releases the shared Scala build resources.
